method: Low-precision published J2000 Kepler elements propagated by orbital period. Not JPL Horizons vectors. No live tracking.
notes: Stellar RA/Dec and distances are approximate catalogue references; not propagated through the journey’s elapsed light-equivalent time.
Moon position uses mean distance, not a dated orbital solution.
Voyager Earth distance propagated approximately from NASA 164.7 AU (2024-08-21) at 3.5 AU/year; direction is illustrative.
